tools.title: Goal
tools.description: Start, replace, or complete the current goal.
tools.promptSnippet: Use goal for explicit sustained objectives; set objective to start/replace, or status="complete" when done.
promptGuidelines: Use goal mode only for explicit requests or sustained autonomous work; ordinary one-shot tasks do not need a goal.
Set objective to start or replace the active goal.
Use status="complete" only when the objective is actually achieved.

objective.description: Start or replace the active goal objective.

status.description: Mark the active goal complete only when the objective is achieved.
